counties.name: Brevard
gaps: 6989 source rows collapsed to 5746 parcel ids (duplicate ids, stacked units, or rings that failed the WGS84 check). The acreage query covered the county.
No zoning or FLU on the Florida DOH extract.

counties.name: Indian River
gaps: Florida DOH 5–150 acre parcels (fl-doh-ehwaters-12061, 191 zoning codes and 104 future land use codes). County parcels were not re-downloaded.
Vero Beach zoning is ZoningDistricts and future land use is ZoningFutureLandUse. Those code lists are not interchangeable. The token-gated COVB folder is not called.
Sebastian zoning is COS_Zoning. Sebastian future land use is still a gap.
Fellsmere, Indian River Shores, and Orchid stay blank. No city FeatureServer was invented.

counties.name: Orange
gaps: Reused the Orlando OCPA 5.0–150.0 acre tiles. Not a second download.
Geometry, owner, mailing, sale, tax, and zoning come from OCPA.

counties.name: Osceola
gaps: Reused the Orlando complete 5.0–150.0 acre tiles. Not re-scraped.

counties.name: Volusia
gaps: City zoning and future land use are joined from municipal REST where a city polygon covers the centroid. Melbourne extract joined zoning on 2942 parcels and FLU on 1914 parcels. Volusia Open Data zoning layer 36 (ZONCODE 999) is not used. DeBary, New Smyrna Beach, Orange City, Lake Helen, and Pierson use CountywideZoning OriginalZoningCode only, not a city FLUM. Daytona Beach Shores and Beverly Beach are zoning-only. Flagler city layers are hosted on gis.palmcoast.gov; this repo has no Flagler parcel baseline.
